To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the disease of rice is mainly due to the presence of the organism in the rhizopshere.
the organism, Pseudomonas putrida, is responsible for the suffication disease of rice in the poorly drained paddy field.
Pseudomonas is the cause of suffocation disease of paddy rice in Taiwan.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following points: 1) the isolation of a new species of bacteria from the diseased rice plants; 2) the identification of the organism by physiological tests and by electron microscope; 3) the reproduction of the disease symptoms by inoculation of this organism on healthy plants; and 4) the elucidation of the relationships of this organism with the suffocation disease.
the development of a method of diagnosis of the suffocation disease and with the isolation and identification of the causal organism.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the disease is due to the denitrifying bacteria ofP. putida.
the disease is caused by the interaction of several factors, i.e., the rice plant, the soil and the organism, in which the organism is the most important factor.

the disease is a result of a combination of the physiological and pathological effects of the organisms, and the environmental factors, such as soil moisture content, soil temperature, soil aeration, and soil fertility.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the organism was a denitrifier, a nitrate reducer and a hydrogen sulfide producer in the rhizosheath, and the disease was a suffocation disease of the rice plant.
the disease is a result of the metabolic process of the organism.
the disease of the rice plant is caused mainly by denitrifying organisms, which are extremely explosive in the diseased rhizosphere.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can use the microbial investigations on the disease to develop a new strategy of disease management in the future.
the organism is a denitrifier which is capable of using nitrate and ammonium sulfate as H2 acceptors.
the suffocation disease is not a disease of rice but rather a disease of the rice farmer, caused by the farmer’s failure to understand the importance of soil drainage.
